service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ,USMT.USER_ID ,USMT.EMAIL FROM SBALN BALN INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND BALN.CTRL_TYPE = 'Q'

SELECT Q.HOUSE_CODE , Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.ADD_DATE , Q.ADD_TIME , QR.QNA_SEQ , QR.ADD_USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.EMAIL FROM SQNAQ Q INNER JOIN SQNAR QR ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = QR.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = QR.QNA_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND QR.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER}

SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER ,Q.COMPANY_CODE ,Q.SUBJECT ,Q.ATTACH_NO ,Q.KEYWORDS ,Q.CONTENT ,Q.ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = Q.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME ,Q.ADD_DATE ,Q.ADD_TIME ,Q.QNA_COMPANY ,Q.QNA_TYPE FROM SQNAQ Q WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT * FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${ATTACH_NO}
